Relation: "location" or "housed at". Object: "University of California Los Angeles Special Collections". That is a department within UCLA. Could be "UCLA Special Collections". Provide object_type: "institution" or "archive". We'll set "institution".

But qualifiers must be attached to a triplet. So we attach qualifier to the main triplet about location.

Thus triplet:

relation: "location"
object: "UCLA Special Collections"
qualifiers: [{"relation":"cataloging status","object":"uncataloged","object_type":"status"}]

But we can produce minimal.
